sanjay: Async standup — GPU fleet headroom check

sanjay: what I did: drained test prewarm in eu-west-3, rerouted live traffic off nodegroup A, validated canary model v2 on 3 pods.

sanjay: blockers: quota bump for AMS spot pool still pending (ticket CL-4521), saw sustained ~18% headroom drop after midnight.

sanjay: today: will follow up with cloud team, open allocation bump PR, prepare fallback plan to run quantized variant on smaller instances if needed.

sanjay: logs/commands:
```bash
kubectl drain node/gpu-a-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

lee: can you paste exact headroom numbers and our emergency threshold? I can flip autoscale burst if needed.

maria: pinging cloud infra now and looping in @nicky. opening quota request via portal, ETA ~3-4h. ticket CL-4521.

alex: FYI there's PR #237 in infra-autoscale to reduce minAvailable from 0.2 -> 0.12, gives ~6 more slots in AMS pool. requesting @sanjay review.

sanjay: headroom numbers: baseline 40 free GPUs, current 33 free, projected to 28 at peak; emergency threshold = 20. so buffer needed is ~8 GPUs. if cloud can't approve, we'll fallback to quantized model and smaller instances.

ops-bot: Capacity alert at 1987654300 — AMS spot pool free GPUs fell below 30 (current 27). https://internal.telemetry/capacity/ams

lee: merging PR helps but we need a release window. if quota denied I'll enable temporary burst: change `maxBurst: 2` -> `maxBurst: 5` for 2h. ok?

maria: cloud replied: 'we can provision up to 4 GPUs within 6h, further increases require justification.' I'll send strong justification now.

alex: if cloud gives +4 and PR yields +6, combined ~+10 which covers +8 target. I'll fast-track review and try to merge before EOD.

sanjay: sounds good — holding off fallback for now. thanks everyone, keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
